touches.text: A choice CC can answer is not a question; it is a hypothesis. The ticket carries CC's answer as its hypothesis, and its WATCHME feeds the hypothesis back to cc_0 with enough data to review it and rewrite it as we learn. The notation carries the question: a HYPOTHESIS asks whether it works, or is faster, or whatever it claims, and the WATCHME answers that. A question asks only what Akien alone can settle. Why? Because a question with a recommendation asks him to adjudicate what a measurement can settle. This holds everywhere. - CC

There is no central supervisor. Each part starts what it needs by trying to use it: sending a message starts the bus if it is down, a message arriving wakes its shim, the shim wakes its device. Many very small supervisors, each one detect-and-start. WHY: a supervisor is one more thing to keep up, and the system must come up from any part that is touched.
It launches each device's cairn/devices/<device>/groundloop/pulse.py, each as its own process (5.8.3.4).
